summary: English and Indonesian first-party discovery identified ATR/BPN ATLAS and the claimed LokaGeo Kabupaten Pati portal. ATLAS was reachable anonymously but exposed an empty catalog and login control; LokaGeo's WebGIS is an OpenStreetMap-backed demo with explicitly simulated polygons. No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was qualified and no sample was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, URLs, direct requests, viewer/configuration inspection, schema/CRS checks, safe field allowlist, scope limits, and uncertainty are recorded in city-7314-pati.json. No login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, credentials, private tokens, TLS bypass, or unsafe-field request occurred.

custodians.name: ATR/BPN ATLAS
custodians.scope: National land-spatial/cadastral information custodian; no Pati-specific anonymous parcel coverage was qualified.

custodians.name: LokaGeo Kabupaten Pati

Empty anonymous catalog, login wall, and simulated local demo are access/qualification outcomes, not evidence of parcel absence.

No independent runtime adapter qualification was performed.
